rules.rule: Use calming, desaturated palettes: mint, sage green, warm white, or soft blue. Avoid jarring red/orange except for alert states. Minimal mood is default.
Progress visualization is central: circular progress rings, linear progress bars, and streak counters must be prominent on home screen. Use animation to celebrate milestones.
Health metrics (steps, heart rate, calories, sleep) should use large number displays with unit label below. Group related metrics in card clusters.
Emergency/crisis features must be immediately accessible (never buried). Safety actions use red only when absolutely necessary and must be clearly labeled.
Positive reinforcement through color and copy: completed states use green checks, streaks use fire emoji or badge, achievements are celebrated with full-screen moments.
